items.title: Add your organization’s runbooks and policies using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
items.summary: In Part 2 of this series, you connect your Kiro DBA assistant to your team's runbooks and policies. Store runbooks in Amazon S3, index them with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL using pgvector, and wire up retrieval so the assistant grounds its recommendations in your own documentation.
items.creator: Narendra Tawar

items.title: Build an AI-powered DBA assistant for Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS with Kiro
items.summary: Learn how to build a DBA assistant with Kiro that investigates and resolves Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL performance incidents through natural language. Using two MCP servers, the agent reads Amazon CloudWatch metrics and Database Insights, runs diagnostic queries, and surfaces fixes you apply through your change management process.
items.creator: Narendra Tawar
